name: What is the difference between installing porcelain tile and natural stone like marble in a bathroom?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between installing porcelain tile and natural stone like marble in a bathroom?

acceptedAnswer.text: Natural stone like marble offers unique, high-end beauty, but it requires periodic sealing and careful maintenance because it is porous. Porcelain tile is engineered to be nearly waterproof, highly scratch-resistant, and virtually maintenance-free. If you want authentic veining and a luxurious feel, marble is an excellent choice, but it can etch when exposed to acidic bathroom cleaners. Porcelain offers a practical tradeoff by mimicking stone aesthetics without the risk of staining or the need for frequent resealing. Both materials require a properly prepped, level subfloor to prevent cracking over time.
acceptedAnswer.description: Porcelain tile is non-porous, highly durable, and low-maintenance, while natural marble provides unique luxury but requires regular sealing and gentle cleaning products.
